market_pulse.theme: Prediction Markets Surge and Regulatory Scrutiny
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple operators and tribal gaming groups are pushing prediction markets into the regulatory spotlight, while investors are adjusting valuations of companies like DraftKings. The trend includes new legislation, market entry challenges, and executive turnover linked to prediction‑market units.

Operators such as Greentube and other iGaming firms are preparing for launches in Alberta as the province opens its market, while broader Canadian regulatory frameworks (Ontario vs. Alberta) are being mapped out. This reflects a strategic push into North America beyond the US.

market_pulse.theme: African Licensing, Market Growth and Regulatory Tightening
market_pulse.narrative: Several African jurisdictions (Rwanda, Kenya, Mauritius) are issuing new licences, imposing penalties for delayed payouts, and outlining new gambling frameworks. At the same time, broader market‑size forecasts and sports‑betting trends underline rapid growth in the region.

market_pulse.theme: Responsible Gambling, Player Protection and Harm Reduction
market_pulse.narrative: New advisory committees (1xCare), research on hidden costs of casino bonuses (Kasinohai), and anonymity‑focused harm‑support reports (BetBlocker) indicate a heightened industry focus on responsible gambling and player‑protection initiatives.

market_pulse.theme: Financial Performance, Shareholder Value and M&A Activity
market_pulse.narrative: Companies such as Lottomatica and Fertitta Entertainment are reporting strong profit growth and outlining integration plans with Caesars, while shareholder‑reward narratives are being used to justify valuations and future strategic moves.
